title: Collins Elite met aliens and considered using them to assassinate

tellings.quote: Then you read about what they did. Well, first we met aliens and then we're like, can we use this to assassinate people?

plain: A secret group called the Collins Elite first met aliens and then asked whether it could use them to assassinate people. That is how the comedian Kurt Metzger puts it to Michels, paraphrasing the group: "first we met aliens and then we're like, can we use this to assassinate people?" He takes it from Final Events, a book by the author Nick Redfern, and also cites a man named Jason Jaconi.
